# maskera

> Swedish-first, client-side PII redaction for AI apps. maskera finds and masks detected Swedish personal data (names, personnummer, addresses, phone numbers, and more) before text reaches an LLM, a log, or analytics. Everything runs on-device (browser via WebGPU/WASM, or Node); text and restore maps are not sent away for masking. The packages contain no telemetry. The demo counts anonymous, cookieless page views, never your content. The default setup fetches the model weights and WASM runtime once as static assets (both can be self-hosted), never your content. Redactions are reversible via a restore map that stays with the caller.

Two layers, rules first:

- `@maskera/core` (npm): deterministic detectors for structured Swedish PII: personnummer, samordningsnummer, organisationsnummer, phone, email, postnummer, bankgiro, plusgiro, IBAN, cards, IP, URL, plus opt-in context-labeled domestic account and journal identifiers. Format checks and selective checksums reject common look-alikes; personnummer detection deliberately retains real-date values with a mistyped Luhn digit. Zero dependencies, synchronous. Custom patterns join via `regexDetector`.
- `maskera` (npm): everything in core plus the published `maskera-sv-ner` v19, my attested privacy-clean Swedish NER model (KB-BERT fine-tuned and distilled to a 43 MB ONNX) that catches free-text names, places, organisations and street addresses, including all-lowercase chat text. Its task-specific training uses 64,000 generated rows and 4,760 disjoint validation rows; on the revised synthetic ADR set its pipeline covers all 57 gold spans exactly with zero leaks, including all 35 marked addresses. One organisation is typed ADDRESS, so labeled F1 is 96.5%. On overlap, rules win. The hybrid also enables the low-risk free-text rule heuristics (street address, lägenhetsnummer) and context-labeled domestic account/journal identifiers by default; `regnummer` is opt-in. Clinical callers can set `profile: "clinical"` to retain common measurements, doses and care terms.

Quick start:

```ts
import { createNerRecognizer, redactWithNer } from "maskera"

const recognizer = createNerRecognizer()
const { text, restore } = await redactWithNer(
  "hej jag heter provnamn maskera, personnummer 19900101-2385, och bor i provbyn",
  { recognizer },
)
// "hej jag heter [NAMN_1], personnummer [PERSONNUMMER_1], och bor i [PLATS_1]"
```

Published-v19 release gates (q4, measured 2026-08-06): curated span F1 96.9% with 1/205 leaks, revised synthetic ADR label-agnostic span F1 100.0% with 0/57 leaks, and rare-surname masked recall 96.94%. Historical v18 public-model comparisons remain separately labeled and do not automatically transfer to v19: https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md

Deployment boundary: the local/on-device claims above apply to this
open-source package and the maskera.dev browser demo. Maskera Gateway is the
commercial deployment for a customer's own servers: a signed OCI container
with the 43 MB model built in. It runs on CPU without a database, GPU or
separate model server, and masks routed AI traffic before the approved
upstream receives it. There is no hosted masking API on offer: the
open-source packages and Gateway are the two deployments. The customer portal
at app.maskera.dev is limited to accounts, licensing, billing, and Gateway
downloads. Customer text is not processed there.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera#readme): install, API, architecture
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): the one canonical, dated, reproducible results table
- [Production notes](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/PRODUCTION.md): deployment and hardening guidance
- [Transparency](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/TRANSPARENCY.md): privacy posture, what runs where
- [Training data protection](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/TRAINING_DATA_PROTECTION.md): published v19's identifier rejection, attestation, and the KB-BERT boundary

## Packages and model

- [maskera on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/maskera): rules + Swedish NER model, core re-exported
- [@maskera/core on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@maskera/core): rules only, zero dependencies
- [maskera-sv-ner on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/joelhagvall/maskera-sv-ner): the 43 MB Swedish NER ONNX model, training details

## Optional

- [Live demo](https://maskera.dev/): paste Swedish text, watch it get masked in the browser
- [For companies](https://maskera.dev/tjanster): compare open source and Gateway (Swedish)
- [Gateway pricing](https://app.maskera.dev/pricing): the canonical commercial plans and prices
- [Gateway](https://app.maskera.dev/gateway): customer-hosted installation, security, and purchase flow
- [Source repository](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera): monorepo with packages, training pipeline, and CI that re-grades the published model against a gold corpus
